```{r}
library(ggplot2)
steam_df <- read.csv("steam_clean.csv")

# this uses base r + matrix algebra instead of
# specialized bayesian libraries like stan or brms
# posterior is computed analytically (closed form)

# -------- Feature Engineering --------
# log-transform skewed features (only if they exist)
log_cols <- c("peak_ccu", "recommendations", "positive", "negative")
for (col in log_cols) {
  if (col %in% names(steam_df)) {
    steam_df[[col]] <- log(steam_df[[col]] + 1)
  }
}

# -------- Log-transform target --------
# converts multiplicative relationships into linear ones
y <- log(steam_df$Price + 1)

# design matrix
# builds X manually for linear regression formulation
x_df <- steam_df[, setdiff(names(steam_df), "Price")]
X <- as.matrix(cbind(Intercept = 1, x_df))

n <- nrow(X)
p <- ncol(X)

# -------- Prior --------
# gaussian prior on coefficients
# inverse-gamma prior on variance
beta0 <- rep(0, p)
B0 <- diag(10, p)
B0_inv <- solve(B0)
a0 <- 2
b0 <- 2

# -------- Posterior --------
# closed-form bayesian update using conjugacy
# no sampling or mcmc required
Bn_inv <- B0_inv + t(X) %*% X
Bn <- solve(Bn_inv)
beta_n <- Bn %*% (B0_inv %*% beta0 + t(X) %*% y)

a_n <- a0 + n / 2
quad_y <- as.numeric(t(y) %*% y)
quad_prior <- as.numeric(t(beta0) %*% B0_inv %*% beta0)
quad_post <- as.numeric(t(beta_n) %*% Bn_inv %*% beta_n)
b_n <- b0 + 0.5 * (quad_y + quad_prior - quad_post)

# -------- Coefficient Summary --------
# computes posterior mean and uncertainty
sigma2_post_mean <- b_n / (a_n - 1)
beta_sd <- sqrt(diag(sigma2_post_mean * Bn))

coef_summary <- data.frame(
  feature = colnames(X),
  posterior_mean = as.numeric(beta_n),
  lower_95 = as.numeric(beta_n) - 1.96 * beta_sd,
  upper_95 = as.numeric(beta_n) + 1.96 * beta_sd
)

coef_summary$abs_effect <- abs(coef_summary$posterior_mean)
coef_summary <- coef_summary[order(-coef_summary$abs_effect), ]

print(head(coef_summary[, c("feature", "posterior_mean", "lower_95", "upper_95")], 20))

# -------- Predictions (log space) --------
# linear predictions in transformed space
pred_log <- as.numeric(X %*% beta_n)

# convert back to price scale
# ensures predictions are positive
pred_mean <- exp(pred_log) - 1

# approximate variance propagation
# uncertainty carried through exponential transform
pred_var_log <- as.numeric((b_n / a_n) * (1 + rowSums((X %*% Bn) * X)))
pred_sd_log <- sqrt(pred_var_log)

pred_lower <- exp(pred_log - 1.96 * pred_sd_log) - 1
pred_upper <- exp(pred_log + 1.96 * pred_sd_log) - 1

# -------- Evaluation --------
# evaluates in original price scale
actual_price <- steam_df$Price
rmse <- sqrt(mean((actual_price - pred_mean)^2))
cat("bayesian linear regression rmse:", round(rmse, 6), "\n")

# -------- Save predictions --------
pred_df <- data.frame(
  actual = actual_price,
  pred = pred_mean,
  lower = pred_lower,
  upper = pred_upper
)

write.csv(pred_df, "bayesian_linear_regression_vs_actual.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# -------- Plot --------
# ggplot2 used only for visualization
p <- ggplot(pred_df, aes(x = actual, y = pred)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.25, size = 1.1, color = "steelblue") +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "firebrick") +
  labs(
    title = "bayesian linear regression vs actual csv",
    x = "actual price",
    y = "predicted price"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

print(p)
```

## part 2: bayesian nonlinear regression (pre-built package)

```{r}
# install.packages("brms")
library(brms)

set.seed(42)

# copy and sanitize names so formulas are easier to write
steam_nonlin <- steam_df
names(steam_nonlin) <- make.names(names(steam_nonlin))
steam_nonlin$log_price <- log(steam_nonlin$Price + 1)

# use smooth terms for nonlinear effects on key engagement variables
nonlinear_formula <- bf(
  log_price ~
    s(Peak.CCU, k = 10) +
    s(Recommendations, k = 10) +
    s(Positive, k = 10) +
    s(Negative, k = 10) +
    s(Average.playtime.forever, k = 10) +
    s(Median.playtime.forever, k = 10) +
    Required.age + DiscountDLC.count +
    Windows + Mac + Linux + Achievements + language_count
)

# weakly informative priors
nonlinear_priors <- c(
  prior(student_t(3, 0, 2.5), class = "Intercept"),
  prior(normal(0, 1), class = "b"),
  prior(exponential(1), class = "sigma"),
  prior(exponential(1), class = "sds")
)

# fit bayesian nonlinear model (gaussian likelihood on log price)
# this may take a few minutes depending on machine speed
fit_nonlin <- brm(
  formula = nonlinear_formula,
  data = steam_nonlin,
  family = gaussian(),
  prior = nonlinear_priors,
  chains = 4,
  iter = 1500,
  warmup = 500,
  cores = getOption("mc.cores", 1),
  seed = 42
)

print(summary(fit_nonlin))

# posterior predictive mean on log scale, then back-transform
post_epred <- posterior_epred(fit_nonlin, ndraws = 1000)
pred_log_nonlin <- colMeans(post_epred)
pred_nonlin <- exp(pred_log_nonlin) - 1

# predictive intervals from posterior draws
pred_log_lower <- apply(post_epred, 2, quantile, probs = 0.025)
pred_log_upper <- apply(post_epred, 2, quantile, probs = 0.975)
pred_lower_nonlin <- exp(pred_log_lower) - 1
pred_upper_nonlin <- exp(pred_log_upper) - 1

actual_nonlin <- steam_nonlin$Price
rmse_nonlin <- sqrt(mean((actual_nonlin - pred_nonlin)^2))
cat("bayesian nonlinear regression rmse:", round(rmse_nonlin, 6), "\n")

pred_nonlin_df <- data.frame(
  actual = actual_nonlin,
  pred = pred_nonlin,
  lower = pred_lower_nonlin,
  upper = pred_upper_nonlin
)

write.csv(pred_nonlin_df, "bayesian_nonlinear_regression_vs_actual.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# predicted vs actual plot
p_nonlin <- ggplot(pred_nonlin_df, aes(x = actual, y = pred)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.20, size = 1.0, color = "darkgreen") +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "firebrick") +
  labs(
    title = "bayesian nonlinear regression vs actual",
    x = "actual price",
    y = "predicted price"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
print(p_nonlin)

# residual plot
p_nonlin_resid <- ggplot(pred_nonlin_df, aes(x = pred, y = actual - pred)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.20, size = 1.0, color = "purple") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    title = "nonlinear model residuals vs predicted",
    x = "predicted price",
    y = "residual (actual - predicted)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
print(p_nonlin_resid)
```
